derivation: from H5382 (נָשָׁה), in the sense of failure;
def: rheumatic or crippled (from the incident to Jacob)

occurrences.text: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew that shrank.
